title: The Robot on Lumumba Boulevard That Only Helped People Cross
conflicts: Prototype count: AFP and IPS (2014) say two robots in 2013, Construction Management (2015) says three; story uses two. Cost: $15,000 (AFP, IPS) for the first generation vs $27,500 (GOOD, Construction Management) for the 2015 robots; each given with its period. Dates: AFP gives June and October 2013, GOOD says early 2013; story uses AFP.
notes: Self-funding via her restaurant firm Planete J rests on one AFP wire report and is attributed to AFP in the prose. GOOD's incorruptible line may be paraphrase, so it is reported, not quoted. Jeune Afrique profile not cited (could not be read in full).
